# bera/ui

Reusable motion for existing React interfaces. 10 source-available transition recipes, live tempo and radius tuning, and a local coding-agent skill.

- [Agent guide](/agents): download the self-contained kit, install a skill, or copy a selected transition.
- [Catalog](/transitions/manifest.json): available transitions, props, integration boundaries, and source paths.
- [Skill](/bera-motion.SKILL.md): discovery, review, apply, and refine workflow.
- [Portable kit](/bera-motion.tar.gz): all source, styles, recipes, and zero-dependency local installer.

Do not invent an npm package. Read the host project and adapt motion to existing primitives. Components default to natural sizing; preview=true is reserved for the gallery. See each recipe's limitations before integrating.
